rules: null SndAliasList or count==0 returns null
list count is asserted below 64 and locally capped to 64
contextType==0 accepts the variant without a context comparison
entity handle low 12 bits select an entity-context row when below 0x700
a matching entity-specific context accepts the variant
contextValue==0 accepts the variant as a wildcard
otherwise SND_FindContextIndex plus the global context table determines acceptance
flags0 bit31 on the first accepted candidate selects a RandWithSeed path using a local seed derived from alias-list address plus objectId
otherwise a nonzero DWORD at g_snd+0x288 selects RandWithSeed on that mutable global word
otherwise libc rand modulo accepted-candidate count is used
when more than two candidates are accepted, the libc-rand path retries an immediate repeat of aliasList.sequence, bounded to 100 attempts
the final accepted-candidate index is written to aliasList.sequence

neverPlayedTwice.flags1Bit1: runtime has-played state returned by SND_AliasHasPlayed
neverPlayedTwice.setter: SND_AliasSetNeverPlayedTwice writes flags1 bit1 to the supplied boolean despite the PDB function name
neverPlayedTwice.gateOrder: after selection and before Secondary processing, bit0 && bit1 causes SND_PlaySoundAlias failure
neverPlayedTwice.successfulDirectStart: all proven new-direct-start success returns after SD_StartAlias call the setter with true

secondary.t6Order: variant is selected first; the selected variant's secondaryName is then processed
secondary.missingImmediateTarget: missing lookup skips Secondary playback and continues primary processing
validation: primary and immediate secondary-list-head flags0 bit0 must agree (looping parity)
downstream Secondary chains are walked through SND_FindAlias/list heads
I_stricmp rejects a chain that references the primary alias name
validation is bounded to ten downstream steps
secondary.playback: a valid Secondary alias list is recursively passed to SND_PlaySoundAlias before the selected primary assetId check
secondary.recursiveResult: the Secondary playback return value is not returned as the primary playback ID

zeroAssetId.directSound: assetId==0 does not start a direct physical sound
zeroAssetId.subtitle: if subtitle is non-null, SND_SubtitleNotify(subtitle,5000) is called
zeroAssetId.runtimeHasPlayed: the zero-direct return occurs before the successful-direct-start flags1 bit1 setter paths

probability.gate: if p>0, random() is called and the selected alias is rejected only when random()>p; when p==0 the random rejection gate is bypassed
probability.order: after variant selection, Secondary processing, nonzero direct asset check, and earlier validity gates

unresolved: human-readable PDB field name for the exact g_snd+0x288 seed word
full lower-level voice/driver semantics outside the explicitly bounded paths
proofBoundary: All promoted behavior is tied to exact MAP symbol identities and exact machine-code slices of the SHA-pinned PC dedicated-server executable. The exact PDB identity is retained as matching symbol provenance. Historical T5 code was used only as a search fingerprint and is not part of the authority chain. No result is promoted to the retail t6mp.exe client.
